description: Source code for the SoftOpus audio decoder component in Android's media framework, implementing Opus decoding using libopus and integrating with OMX (OpenMAX) interface.

classes.name: SoftOpus
classes.description: A class implementing an Opus decoder component for Android's media framework, handling decoding, port configuration, and state management.

methods.name: SoftOpus
methods.description: Constructor initializing the SoftOpus decoder component, setting default parameters, and initializing ports and decoder.

methods.name: ~SoftOpus
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up decoder and header resources.

methods.name: initPorts
methods.description: Initializes input and output ports with appropriate configurations.

methods.name: initDecoder
methods.description: Initializes the decoder; currently a stub returning OK.

methods.name: internalGetParameter
methods.description: Handles retrieval of various OMX parameters related to audio port format, Android Opus settings, and PCM configuration.

methods.name: internalSetParameter
methods.description: Handles setting of OMX parameters including component role, port format, and Android Opus parameters.

methods.name: isConfigured
methods.description: Checks if the decoder has been configured with at least one input buffer.

methods.name: ReadLE16
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit little-endian value from data at a specified offset.

methods.name: ParseOpusHeader
methods.description: Parses the Opus header to extract channel count, skip samples, gain, and stream map.

methods.name: ns_to_samples
methods.description: Converts nanoseconds to number of samples based on sample rate.

methods.name: handleEOS
methods.description: Handles end-of-stream by signaling EOS buffers and updating state.

methods.name: onQueueFilled
methods.description: Main processing loop for decoding input buffers into output PCM buffers, handling header parsing, decoder creation, and decoding frames.

methods.name: onPortFlushCompleted
methods.description: Resets decoder state upon port flush.

methods.name: onReset
methods.description: Resets internal state and destroys decoder.
